candidate_program.name: greedy_neighbor_exchange
candidate_program.rationale: Subtracts one feasible packing of active conflicts from root reward, adding a small count-scaled root bonus. Neighborhood greedy work can exceed aggregate scans, and its packing can underestimate alternative reward.

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
